MutateWorkspaceScopedWithAggregate.reason: Off mode forwards the literal original accessor/context. Bounded callbacks use the exact installed logical preimage with declared P15 inputs, live authorization, bounded external hydration/reference refresh, legacy nested aggregate closure and publication work held through sinks. Named CAS conflicts refresh only bounded declared records before retry; point and complete-field merges/deletions install the actual persisted postimage without recomputing pre-persist events. Coordinator reload reserves policy work before writer locking. New unavailable native leaves reject before commit; timestamp receipts retain audited parser provenance. SW27-33 source/aggregate/permission/ownership tests and SW36 persistent point/full-field differentials compare callback attempts, returned/native values, SQL, webhook previous values/snapshots and realtime, including warm NUL, peer merge/delete, coordinator retry, nil append, import inputs and cancellation. Ordinary P15 selections retain their existing limits. Stored inline fields use separately admitted complete-field selection, occurrence-aware read-only validation and the shared exact inline postimage; legal large unrelated roots use cached fixed-chunk headers and streamed root patching. SW188 compares literal SQL root bytes, canonical rows, native values and publication through warm/reloaded duplicate-point and complete-field writes, nil/empty and split transitions, cancellation and skipped-body validation. Domain callbacks and high-cardinality unported consumers are not certified by this adapter review.
